summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of broadband connectivity in modern public education and the potential financial and operational impacts of reducing or eliminating E-Rate support. The school district urges the FCC to preserve and improve E-Rate rather than sunset it, emphasizing its critical role in providing broadband infrastructure for schools and libraries.
filer_raw: Dr. Rob Darling | Grandview School District #200
